subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “She also discussed problems: changing wind, noise concerns, bird safety, and where power lines should go.”?
options: The three students laughed, but Sam was still hungry.
Students realized clean energy still requires choices and trade-offs.
Clean energy became less abstract when students could watch it being made above their own classrooms.
Students then designed posters about unusual ways to store energy.
